summary: Final regression validated login, home, builder, 2D planta, orçamento and offers recovery at 390x844. All API regression tests pass and GET /api/offers currently returns HTTP 200 JSON; no red screen or horizontal overflow occurred.

ui_bugs.issue: Inline recovery card is cramped on 390px mobile: error message wraps into a very narrow column and the retry button overlaps/crowds the message.

issues: Error card needs a vertical layout or full-width retry button so message and action remain readable at 390x844.

action_items: Rework Offers error card spacing/flex direction for narrow mobile widths.
Align frontend API configuration with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL key (or explicitly preserve and document the configured EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL fallback).
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the requested/protected frontend key EXPO_BACKEND_URL is absent; this is currently functional only because the alternate key is configured.
Most core interactive controls still lack testID attributes, reducing robust mobile regression coverage; requested offers testIDs are present.
Backend logs retain a passlib/bcrypt compatibility warning during password operations, although login tests pass.
seed_data_creation: Existing regression test creates TEST_regression_project records; no seeded data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use demo@constroifacil.app / senha123 and public preview https://build-discount-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Offers upstream is NOT MOCKED; current public endpoint normalizes failure to HTTP 200 JSON with offers: [] and error. Verify error-card layout after fixes.
rca_of_issue: The offers failure state uses a horizontal flex row for icon, title/body, and retry button. At 390px, the middle text flexes too narrowly while the button retains width, causing excessive wrapping and visual crowding/overlap. API failure handling itself is recovered correctly: request rejection is caught and offers-retry renders without an Expo red screen.
